data.one_liner: Check if the current Android or iOS device supports eSIM compatibility.
data.what_it_does: Checks whether the current Android or iOS device supports eSIM using native platform code. Provides a simple asynchronous method to return a boolean compatibility result.
use_when: You need to check eSIM compatibility before prompting users for eSIM activation.
You are building a telecom or carrier app targeting Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need to manage or install eSIM profiles rather than just checking device capability.
You are targeting web, desktop, or unsupported platforms.
strengths: Uses native Android and iOS code for accurate detection.
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS platforms.
iOS detection relies on a hardcoded device model list that requires updates for new devices.
data.setup_notes: No extra permissions required. Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general device and OS information which can be used to manually inspect OS versions and hardware properties.
